name: NoOnes
rootCause: The peer-to-peer cryptocurrency trading platform NoOnes suffered a major security breach earlier this month. CEO Ray Youssef explained that the breach occurred on January 1st due to an exploit involving their Solana bridge.

descriptions.text: The peer-to-peer cryptocurrency trading platform NoOnes suffered a major security breach earlier this month. CEO Ray Youssef explained that the breach occurred on January 1st due to an exploit involving their Solana bridge.

On January 1, 2025, NoOnes suffered a cross-chain exploit targeting its hot wallets across Ethereum, BNB Chain, Solana, and Tron, resulting in losses of about $7.9 million. The breach involved a vulnerability in the Solana bridge, leading to rapid draining of funds via hundreds of small withdrawals and subsequent laundering through Tornado Cash. No detailed code-level analysis is available. The established basis is a vulnerability in the Solana bridge used by NoOnes, permitting unauthorized withdrawals from hot wallets across several chains. Exact technical specifics (such as the mechanism for message spoofing or bridge authentication failure) remain unreported in public sources.
